comment: Native path. Only two model calls exist for the whole scenario: Esc rejects the tool's execute, so the step has a call with no result and the AI SDK stops stepping. Turn 2 is therefore the user's SECOND message - a mid-turn call would take that slot with the denial as its last user message and fail the mustContain below.

match.comment: 4: [user('make a note'), assistant(text + tool-call), tool(the denial, re-paired by pairStoppedToolCalls), user('second message')]. Without the re-pairing the tool call would be unpaired, dropUnpairedToolCalls would strip it, and the turn - the user's own message included - would not commit at all.
